content.user_title: Add x402 Paywalls to API Routes
content.value_statement: Charging agents per API request requires payment checks before protected work runs. This guide outlines x402 integration for FastAPI and Express using stablecoins and external verification.
actual_capabilities: Outlines x402 payment requirements and HTTP 402 responses for unpaid requests.
Describes FastAPI route dependencies for protecting selected endpoints.
Describes Express middleware as a route-level paywall integration approach.
Identifies external facilitators for server-side payment-proof verification.
Provides a FastAPI request example using Base Sepolia and a 0.10 USDC price.
limitations: The package contains one guide, without bundled scripts, extension source, templates, or executable middleware.
The documented framework scope is limited to FastAPI and Express.
Server-side verification requires an external facilitator; this guide provides no complete configuration or integration.
The guide describes mocked payment proofs for local tests but includes no test suite or evidence of live settlement.

use_cases.title: Protect an expensive generation route
use_cases.description: Use the guide to plan a FastAPI dependency that checks payment before an image-generation endpoint performs expensive work.

use_cases.title: Introduce selective API billing
use_cases.description: Plan Express middleware for paid endpoints while keeping public routes unchanged.

use_cases.title: Prototype agent micropayments
use_cases.description: Explore a test-network USDC payment flow for agents consuming metered services.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the payment flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the x402 request flow for a FastAPI route, including missing proof, HTTP 402 requirements, and facilitator verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner exploration before choosing an integration.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a FastAPI paywall
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an x402 paywall for my FastAPI image-generation route at 0.10 USDC on Base Sepolia. Identify required configuration and keep public routes unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: Initial implementation planning for one paid endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Express payment checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Express routes and propose x402 middleware for selected paid endpoints. Identify a compatible facilitator and verify payment before protected work starts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate integration into an existing Node.js service.

prompt_templates.title: Review payment enforcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my x402 integration for proof replay, incorrect payment amounts, network mismatches, and facilitator outages. Propose failure tests and identify unverified settlement assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review requiring application code and current protocol documentation.

output_examples.input: Plan a 0.10 USDC paywall for a FastAPI image-generation endpoint on Base Sepolia.
output: Attach a payment dependency only to the selected image-generation route.
Return HTTP 402 with payment requirements when payment proof is absent.
Verify payment through a compatible facilitator before running generation.
Confirm recipient, asset, network, and price configuration before testing.

output_examples.input: Describe how to add paid routes to an Express API without changing public routes.
output: Mount payment middleware on selected paid routes rather than globally.
Validate payment proof before invoking protected handlers.
Leave public routes outside the payment middleware.
Test missing and invalid proofs; verify live behavior separately from mocked tests.

best_practices: Verify current x402 and facilitator documentation before choosing dependencies or implementing payment checks.
Validate payment before protected work and confirm recipient, asset, amount, and network.
Test unpaid, invalid, and successful requests on a test network before enabling production payments.
anti_patterns: Treating this public guide as bundled, audited payment middleware.
Trusting client payment claims without server-side verification.
Assuming mocked proofs demonstrate successful live payment settlement.

faq.question: What is included in this package?
faq.answer: One SKILL.md guide is included. Scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are not included.

faq.question: Which frameworks does the guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers FastAPI route dependencies and Express middleware.

faq.question: Which assets and networks are discussed?
faq.answer: The guide focuses on USDC and networks such as Base. Its example uses Base Sepolia.

faq.question: Is an external verification service required?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented approach uses an external facilitator for server-side payment-proof verification.

faq.question: Must every API endpoint require payment?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes protecting selected routes while leaving public endpoints and existing business logic unchanged.

faq.question: Does the package prove production payment security?
faq.answer: No. It contains no executable implementation or tests. Generated integrations need independent review and testing with a compatible facilitator.
